gen-gf-vibes-instrument-sans: Tight and loud: Vibes packs its lowercase up toward the caps, while Instrument Sans keeps every stroke at a constant weight. Vibes earns its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-vibes-inter: Distinctive at a glance, Vibes huddles its letters tight, while Inter opens big, breathing counters in a tall lowercase. Vibes shouts best up top; Inter does its best work underneath.
gen-gf-vibes-poppins: Dense, loud lowercase takes the lead here. Vibes crowds its letters up toward the caps, and Poppins loosens everything below with rope-loose curves and no thick-thin flicker to catch the eye.
gen-gf-vibes-roboto-slab: Bold, huddled Vibes holds one pen-line width throughout, a loud counterpart to the precise slab-serif below. Roboto Slab turns a lengthy text into a firm, structured texture, its open throats keeping the middle of each line clear.
gen-gf-vibes-rubik: Steel-rod thin and tightly huddled, Vibes sets off Rubik, whose lowercase looks big beside its capitals. Round, open letters keep Rubik soft and easy to follow across whole paragraphs.
gen-gf-vidaloka-fs-bespoke-sans: Stark swings between bold black columns and spiderweb-fine strokes define Vidaloka, with Bespoke Sans offering generous space beside its curves. Vidaloka makes the noise; Bespoke Sans quietly keeps up.
gen-gf-volkhov-fs-bespoke-sans: Traditional in manner, Volkhov tapers gently where strokes bend. Bespoke Sans then carries the text in sharp, refined lines, leaving generous space between curve ends and stems, which reads smoothly paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-vollkorn-fs-bespoke-sans: A tempered contrast that neither jolts nor flattens gives Vollkorn its literary, traditional character. Bespoke Sans joins it as a sharp, refined sans-serif, its curve ends standing generously apart from the stems.
gen-gf-vollkorn-sc-fs-bespoke-sans: Vollkorn SC has a bookish, editorial look, its open curves carrying a hint of wedge-shaped pen pressure. Bespoke Sans handles the sharp, refined side, leaving generous space between curve ends and stems.
gen-gf-voltaire-fs-literata: Tight, spaghetti-thin lines make Voltaire unmistakable, with barely any gap between letters. Literata brings mild contrast and wide, unclosed curves, so giving it a generous size is worth doing.
